sentences.en: The vacuum cleaner is giving off an odor of ozone.
sentences.zh: 吸尘器散发出臭氧的味道。

sentences.en: The ozone layer continues to be further destroyed every year.
sentences.zh: 臭氧层每年都在进一步遭到破坏。

sentences.en: Without the ozone layer, we would be in danger.
sentences.zh: 没有臭氧层，我们将处于危险之中。

senses.zh: 臭氧；新鲜的空气 形容词: ozonic
